headline: ISW/AEI assess China may be running a major unannounced exercise simulating Taiwan's isolation -- MISSED CATCH-UP'
dek: China may be conducting large-scale unannounced military exercises in the Western Pacific simulating the isolation of Taiwan, larger than the PLA's Justice Mission 2025 exercises, drawing on forces from three theater commands including the Liaoning carrier strike group. Taiwan NSC chief Joseph Wu…
sources: Institute for the Study of War / American Enterprise Institute joint report (China & Taiwan Update, Nov 6), via Taipei Times; UA.NEWS Nov 8 01:34Z
fault_line: Is China rehearsing a blockade of Taiwan right now without telling anyone -- or is this just the usual pressure, dressed up as an invasion drill?

sections.what_happened: China may be conducting large-scale unannounced military exercises in the Western Pacific simulating the isolation of Taiwan, larger than the PLA's Justice Mission 2025 exercises, drawing on forces from three theater commands including the Liaoning carrier strike group. Taiwan NSC chief Joseph Wu said Nov 3 that more than 100 PLAN and China Coast Guard vessels were operating in the Western Pacific; Taiwan MND logged 49 aircraft sorties on Nov 2. Two concentrations: four task groups from three PLA commands between Taiwan and Guam, and at least six CCG vessels plus PLAN ships around Taiwan.
sections.what_verified: 3 distinct tiered families: ISW (T3, ANALYSIS -- the assessment itself), Taipei Times / Focus Taiwan (T3 -- reporting the assessment), Taiwan MND (T1, STATE TW -- corroborates the underlying activity counts: 49 sorties Nov 2, daily counts -- but NOT the exercise inference). AEI is not in the registry and adds no family.
sections.what_disputed: China has not announced or named any exercise -- a departure from its last four major drills, which were named; the ISW assessment itself notes this. Taiwan MND daily counts for Nov 6-7 (11 aircraft, 10 ships) are routine-scale, far below the Nov 2 spike of 49 sorties. Social commentary splits between encirclement/blockade-rehearsal readings and 'salami-slicing plus media posturing'. The Dec 2025 Justice Mission 2025 live-fire drills are a separate, earlier, NAMED event -- do not conflate them with this unannounced activity.
sections.why_matters: Over 100 Chinese warships around Taiwan -- and Beijing hasn't announced a drill. The think tank that tracks this says it may be the biggest isolation rehearsal yet.
sections.context: Background: ISW/AEI assess China may be running a major unannounced exercise simulating Taiwan's isolation -- MISSED CATCH-UP

totw_analysis: Our read: Over 100 Chinese warships around Taiwan -- and Beijing hasn't announced a drill. The think tank that tracks this says it may be the biggest isolation rehearsal yet. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is China rehearsing a blockade of Taiwan right now without telling anyone -- or is this just the usual pressure, dressed up as an invasion drill?
